Resource Profile: BIH PR Seno Diagnose Benigne

Official URL: https://www.senologie.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/senologie-diagnose-benigne Version: 0.10.0
Draft as of 2026-10-12 Computable Name: Senologie_Diagnose_Benigne

Benigne Mamma-Diagnosen (D24, N60-N64) und entzündliche Erkrankungen. ISiK-kompatibel für Krankenhaus-Interoperabilität ohne Krebsregister-Anforderungen.

Usages:

  • Examples for this Profile: Condition/Fall11-Diagnose-Fibroadenom

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
